page.overview:
Who is Michael J. Lin?

Michael J. Lin was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, he held the rank of captain, and was the commander of the . After stardate 41601.3, he received an order about his request for a refit of his ship's warp sensor grids from Admiral Gregory Quinn of Starfleet Operational Support Services. (, okudagram)
